searchText: After we launched the state network, some nodes' discv5 processing capacity exceeded the load, continuously discarding requests, leading to a failure to respond to PING. I want to know if other clients are experiencing this problem. Is it because our utp/discv5 implementation has poor performance? <@240180844130598912> can you answer this? Are the state bridges for 21 million and onwards running? What's load looking like on the trin state nodes? > Are the state bridges for 21 million and onwards running? They are running. Currently only 90% of content being offered is making it onto the network > What's load looking like on the trin state nodes? Extremely low So I would say Trin's performance isn't good, but that doesn't appear to be due to a lack of resources
